I'm a producer and audio engineer for podcasts. + + I've sound designed and mixed podcasts for The Guardian, ABC, and iHeart Australia. + + I made Umwelt, a podcast about how different animals experience the world. + + Currently, I'm senior audio engineer for the iHeart Australia podcast network.

Teaching

-

A bit about lorem ipsum.

+

I teach a podcasting course at University of Sydney, lecture for other educational institutions and community organisations, and work with individuals and businesses to develop and improve their podcast production workflow.

Coding

-

A bit about lorem ipsum.

+

I often write code to automate aspects of my podcast production work (usually in Python or Lua). + + I also like to play around with code, just for fun. Like with this website that plays bird sounds that were recorded under the current position of the International Space Station. + + In 2021, me and my colleague Alex Tighe created a podcast that gives up-to-the-minute weather forecasts, geotargeted to the listener's location (within Australia).
